title: Timeline
description: A vertical list of events with a coloured dot and a line joining them, newest first. The newest event is bold with a soft ring around its dot. An event can carry one attachment shown under its text as a preview: an image as a thumbnail, any other file as a chip with its name and size. Pressing the preview opens a dialog (Modal shell, no footer buttons) with the full image, or the file details and a Download link when the file has an address, and a close button.

events.text: A support specialist took your request

props.t: { text, meta, dot?, fileName?, fileUrl?, fileSize? }[]
props.x: Newest first. dot is the colour: navy for people, amber for status changes, green for resolved, grey for cancelled. fileSize is a number of bytes or ready text. An image is recognised from the file extension and needs fileUrl for the thumbnail.

values.v: 18px below each event, 14px between dot and text
168 x 112px, radius 10px, 1px #e5e7eb, shown under the event text; border darkens on hover
pill #eaeef5, #25395c, 12px / 600, icon 13px (image or paperclip), name and size
Modal shell 720px wide, no footer; image max height 56vh on #f4f6f9; Download link (outline pill) when fileUrl exists

usedIn: School Requests - Self Service and Ticket Inbox (Activity, in the summary panel and the full request page).
